description_en: Creates an ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) queue
description_zh: 本接口用于创建媒体处理管道，实现媒体文件的自动化和批量处理
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-pipeline --name test-pipeline --speed Standard --priority 6 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipeline

parameters.description_en: The name of the MPS queue.
parameters.help_en: The name of the MPS queue
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en:
The type of the MPS queue. Valid values:

1. Standard: standard MPS queue.

2. Boost: MPS queue with transcoding speed boosted.

3. NarrowBandHDV2: MPS queue that supports Narrowband HD 2.0.
parameters.description_zh:
管道类型。取值：

- Standard：标准管道

- Boost：倍速转码管道

- NarrowBandHDV2：窄带高清2.0管道
